name: Song of Kings
text:
Attach to a hero.
Attached hero gains a [leadership] resource icon.
flavor:
From the ashes a fire shall be woken,
A light from the shadows shall spring:
Renewed shall be blade that was broken,
The crownless again shall be king.
<cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

name: Nor am I a Stranger
text: Attach to a character. Attached character gains the Rohan trait.
flavor: "Nor indeed am I a stranger: for I have been in this land before, more than once, and ridden with the host of the Rohirrim, though under other name and in other guise." <cite>Aragorn, The Two Towers</cite>

name: Song of Wisdom
text:
Attach to a hero.
Attached hero gains a [lore] resource icon.
flavor:
It sit beside the fire and think
of all that I have seen,
of meadow-flowers and butterflies
in summers that have been
<cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

name: Haldir of Lórien
text: Ranged. Sentinel.
flavor: "But there are some of us still who go abroad for the gathering of news and the watching of our enemies, and they speak the languages of other lands." <cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

name: Song of Travel
text:
Attach to a hero.
Attached hero gains a [spirit] resource icon.
flavor:
The Road goes ever on and on
Down from the door where it began.
Now far ahead the road has gone,
And I must follow, if I can.
<cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

name: Song of Battle
text:
Attach to a hero.
Attached hero gains a [tactics] resource icon.
flavor: We go, we go, we go to war, to hew the stone and break the door. <cite>The Two Towers</cite>

name: Boots from Erebor
text: Attach to a Dwarf or Hobbit character. Limit 1 Boots from Erebor per character. Attached character gets +1 hit point.

name: Dúnedain Wanderer
text: Ranged. Sentinel. Secrecy 3.
flavor:
They roamed at will southwards, and eastwards even as far as the Misty Mountains; but they were no few and rarely seen.
<cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

name: Sword that was Broken
text:
Attach to a hero.
Attached hero gains a [leadership] resource icon.
If attached hero is Aragorn, each character you control gets +1 [willpower].
flavor:
"For the Sword that was Broken is the Sword of Elendil that broke beneath him when he fell."
<cite>Aragorn, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

name: Ring Mail
text: Attach to a Dwarf or Hobbit character. Restricted. Attached character gets +1 hit point and +1 [defense].
flavor:
"And all the arrows of all the hunters in the world would be in vain..."
<cite>Gimli, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

name: Light of Valinor
text: Attach to a Noldor or Silvan hero. Attached hero does not exhaust to commit to a quest.
flavor:
"... those who have dwelt in the blassed realm live at once in both worlds, and against both the Seen and Unseen they have great power."
<cite>Gandalf, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

name: Hardy Leadership
text: Attach to a [leadership] hero. Each Dwarf gets +1 hit point.
flavor:
"We will seek the hidden door together. And we will come through. In the ruins of of the Dwarves, a dwarf's head will be less easy to bewilder than Elves or Men or Hobbits."
<cite>Gandalf, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

name: Defender of Rammas
flavor: "And the Enemy must pay dearly for the crossing of the River." <cite>Denethor, The Return of the King</cite>

name: Gondorian Shield
text: Attach to a hero. Restricted. Limit 1 per hero. Attached hero gains +1 [defense]. (+2 [defense] instead if attached hero has the Gondor trait.)
flavor:
There flowered a White Tree, and that was for Gondor...
<cite>The Return of the King</cite>

name: Ring of Barahir
text: Attach to a hero. Attached hero gets +1 hit point for each Artifact attachment attached to it. If attached hero is Aragorn, he also gains a [lore] resource icon.

name: Sword of Morthond
text: Attach to a Gondor ally. Attached ally gains the Outlands trait.
flavor:
The Morthond Valye made a great bay that beat up against the sheer southern faces of the mountains.
<cite>The Return of the King</cite>

name: Visionary Leadership
text: Attach to a Gondor hero. While attached hero has at least 1 resource in its resource pool, Gondor characters get +1 [willpower].
flavor: "...still the lords of Gondor have keener sight than lesser men..." <cite>Denethor, The Return of the King</cite>

name: Rivendell Scout
text: Secrecy 2.
flavor: "Elrond is sending Elves, and they will get in touch with the Rangers, and maybe with Thranduil's folk in Mirkwood." <cite>Gandalf, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

name: Elven Mail
text: Restricted. Attach to a Noldor or Silvan character. Attached character gets +2 hit points and gains sentinel.
flavor: ...they were tall and and clad in grey mail, and from their shoulders hung long white cloaks. <cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

name: Cloak of Lórien
text: Attach to a Noldor or Silvan character. Limit 1 per character. Attached character gets +1 [defense] (+2 [defense] instead if the active location has the Forest trait).
flavor: It was hard to say what colour they were: grey with the hue of twilight under the trees they seemed to be; and yet if they were moved, or set in another light, they were green as shadowed leaves... <cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

name: Warden of Helm's Deep
text: Sentinel.
flavor: They now learned to their joy that Erkenbrand had left many men to hold Helm's Gate, and more had since escaped thither. <cite>The Two Towers</cite>

name: Elf-friend
text: Attach to a character. Attached character gains the Noldor and Silvan traits.
flavor:
"I name you Elf-friend; and may the stars shine upon the end of your road!"
<cite>Gildor, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

name: In Service of the Steward
text: Attach to a character. Attached character gains the Gondor trait.
flavor:
But be it known that I have now sworn him to my service...
<cite>The Return of the King</cite>

name: Raiment of War
text: Attach to a Warrior character. Raiment of War counts as 2 Restricted attachments. Attached character gets +1 [attack], +1 [defense] and +2 hit points.
flavor:
Now men came bearing raiment of war from the king's hoard...
<cite>The Two Towers</cite>

name: Strider
text:
Attach to a hero.
While you control 2 or fewer heroes, attached hero does not exhaust to commit to the quest.
While you control 5 or fewer characters, attached hero gets +2 [willpower].
flavor:
"Strider can take you by paths that are seldom tridden. Will you have him?"
<cite>Aragorn, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

name: Knight of the White Tower
text: Knight of the White Tower's resource cost must be paid from a single hero’s resource pool.
flavor:
"...to be only a man of arms of the Guard of the Tower of Gondor is held worthy in the City, and such men have honour in the land." 
<cite>Beregond, The Return of the King</cite>

name: Ent Draught
text: Play only if you control at least 1 Ent character. Attach to a character. Limit 1 per character. Attached character gets +2 hit points.
flavor: The effect of the draught began at the toes, and rose steadily through every limb, bringing refreshment and vigour as it coursed upwards, right to the tips of the hair. <cite>The Two Towers</cite>

name: Friend of Friends
text: Attach to a Hobbit hero. Limit 2 copies of Friend of Friends in play. While another hero has Friend of Friends attached, attached hero gets +1 [willpower], +1 [attack], +1 [defense] and +1 hit point.
flavor: "Come, Mr. Frodo!" he cried, "I can't carry it for you, but I can carry you and it as well." <cite>Sam Gamgee, The Return of the King</cite>

name: Mirkwood Long-knife
text: Attach to a Silvan hero. Restricted. Attached hero gets +1[willpower] and +1[attack].
flavor:
Legolas had a bow and a quiver, and at his belt a long white knife.
<cite>The Return of the King</cite>

name: Fireside Song
text: Attach to a Hobbit hero. Limit 1 per hero. Attached hero gets +1 [willpower] for each Song attached to it.
flavor:
"I sit beside the fire and think
of how the world will be
when winter comes without a spring
that I shall ever see." -Bilbo Baggins, The Fellowship of the Ring

name: Hauberk of Mail
text: Attach to a Dale or Warrior character. Limit 1 per character. Attached character gets +1 [defense] (and +1 hit point if attached character has the sentinel keyword).
flavor:
Each one of his folk was clad in a hauberk of steel mail that hung to his knees…
<cite>The Hobbit</cite>

name: Squire's Helm
text:
Attach to an ally. Restricted.
Limit 1 per ally. 
Attached ally gets +2 hit points.
flavor:
“There are no great weapon-hoards here, lord,” answered Éomer. “Maybe a light helm might be found to fit him...”
<cite>The Return of the King</cite>

name: Ancestral Armor
text: Attach to a [leadership] or Noble character. Restricted. Limit 1 per character Attached characters gets +2 [defense] and +2 hit points.
flavor: "May it keep you well!" said Theoden. "It was made for me in Thengel's day, while still I was a boy." - The Two Towers

name: Warrior Sword
text: Restricted. Attach to a [tactics] or Warrior character. Limit 1 per character. Attached character gets +1 [attack] for each enemy engaged with you. (Limit +3 [attack].)

name: Valiant Determination
text: Attach to an ally. Attached ally does not exhaust to quest.

name: Armor of Erebor
text:
Attach to a Dale or Dwarf character. Restricted. 
Attached character gets +1 [defense] and gains sentinel.
flavor: "We make good armour and keen swords, but we cannot again make mail or blade to match those that were made before the dragon came." —Glóin, The Fellowship of the Ring

name: Silver Circlet
text: Restricted. Attach to a [spirit] hero. Limit 1 per hero. Restricted. Attached hero gets +2 [willpower].
flavor:
His hair was dark as the shadows of twilight, and upon it was set a circlet of silver...
-The Fellowship of the Ring

name: War Axe
text:
Attach to a [tactics] character. Limit 1 per character. 
Restricted. 
Attached characters gets +1 [attack] for each attachment it has with the restricted keyword.
flavor:
"Gimli Glóin"s son, have you your axe ready?"
-Éomer, The Return of the King

name: Golden Belt
text:
Attach to a hero. Limit 1 per hero. 
Attached hero can have 1 additional restricted attachment.
flavor:
The lady bowed her head, and she turned then to Boromir, and to him she gave a belt of gold...
-The Fellowship of the Ring

name: Valiant Sword
text: Restricted. Attach to a Noble hero. Limit 1 per hero. Restricted. Attached hero gets +1 [attack] (+2 [attack] if your threat is 40 or higher).
flavor:
...his sword of steel was valiant...
-The Fellowship of the Ring

name: Shining Shield
text: Attach to a Noble hero. Limit 1 per hero. Restricted. Attached hero gets +1 [defense] (+2 [defense] instead if your threat is 40 or higher).
flavor:
...his shinning shield was scored with runs...
-The Fellowship of the Ring

name: Tireless Thoroughbred
text: Restricted. Attach to a Warrior character. Restricted. Attached character gains ranged and sentinel.
flavor:
Then he leapt forward, spurring the earth, and was gone like the north wine from the mountains.
-The Two Towers.

name: Rivendell Blade
text: Attach to a Noldor or Silvan character. Restricted. When attached character attacks an enemy, that enemy gets -2 [defense] until the end of the phase.

name: Resourceful
text:
Secrecy 3.
Attach to a hero you control.
Attached hero collects 1 additional resource during the resource phase each round.

name: Path of Need
text:
Limit 1 per deck. Attach to a location.
Heroes do not exhaust to attack, defend, or commit to a quest while attached location is the active location.
flavor:
"However it may prove, one must tread the path that need chooses!"
<cite>Gandalf, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

name: Healing Herbs
text: Attach to a [lore] hero. Action: Discard Healing Herbs and exhaust attached hero to heal all damage on 1 character.

name: Asfaloth
text: Attach to a Noldor or Silvan hero. Action: Exhaust Asfaloth to place 1 progress token on any location. (2 tokens instead if attached hero is Glorfindel.)
flavor: Suddenly into view below came a white horse, gleaming in the shadows, running swiftly. In the dusk its headstall flickered and flashed as if it were studded with gems like living stars. <cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>
